rules.accepted_credit_types: Formally organized learning or home study (full hour value): accredited college courses, university CE programs, government agencies/licensed facilities/hospitals, or sponsors certified/approved by IAMFC, AAMFT, AASCB, ACA, APA, CRCC, NAADAC, NASW, NBCC, a national behavioral health organization or certification body, AASCB/other state counseling board approved sponsors, AAPC. Individual activities: publications, presentations, new program development (max 8 h each; books 18 h), dissertation (18 h), clinical supervision/consultation received (max 10 h), leadership (max 8 h), practice-related programs (max 8 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed by examination: exempt from continuing competency for the first renewal after initial licensure.
rules.alternatives: Up to 2 of the 20 hours may be met by unpaid counseling of low-income patients of a local health department or free clinic (3 hours service = 1 CE hour). Dually licensed persons (LPC/LMFT/LSATP) complete one set of 20 hours.
rules.audit_note: Keep original documentation 2 years after renewal; random audits after each renewal period (18VAC115-20-107).

topics.who: Ethics, standards of practice or laws governing behavioral science professions in Virginia

rules.notes: Annual renewal on or before June 30 with attestation of continuing competency.
